newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH POWER BOURSE PLANS SWEDISH CROWN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH POWER BOURSE PLANS SWEDISH CROWN TRADE.

text.p: El-Ex, an electricity exchange operated by Finnish derivatives exchange SOM, is to start trade in Swedish crowns and launch firm forward contracts with physical delivery, SOM said on Thursday.

"The (Swedish crown) product shall have physical delivery with trading close to the operating hour," SOM said, adding that the new firm forward contracts would complement the financial forwards and day-ahead physical contracts quoted in the Norwegian-Swedish Nord Pool markets.
It said it planned to launch the new crown products in August-September this year.
It also said it had granted membership to eight Swedish players who would access current El-Ex markka markets through an electronic system.
"All in all El-Ex has now 42 members, of which 33 Finnish," it said.
